proposalConstraints: Freeze the exact dependency-cruiser rule/options semantics actually required by the five selected proofed rules.
Runtime-cycle detection must exclude any cycle path broken by a type-only dependency.
Production devDependency enforcement is runtime-only; type-only production use and tests remain allowed.
Keep undeclared-package health separate from unused-dependency entropy ownership.
Use explicit selected rules, not the broader recommended bundle.
Keep whole-graph execution; do not add changed-file planning, baseline/cache state, or waivers.
Keep dependency-cruiser repository-local and outside quality:gate.
Do not absorb Knip, orphan detection, typecheck/build/tests, Formal Full Test, architecture layering, Registry, Planner, or lifecycle state.
